dialogues.speaker: Lanoire
dialogues.text: It's too bad Cater isn't here! If he was, he could enjoy this with us too!

dialogues.speaker: Earnshaw
dialogues.text: Even if Cater was here, you still wouldn't be allowed to drink any more Fonta today.

dialogues.speaker: Lanoire
dialogues.text: Awww... But Cater said, you have to share with others to be even more happy!

dialogues.speaker: Earnshaw
dialogues.text: I'm sure Cater also said not to have too much sugar and to brush your teeth after eating.

dialogues.speaker: Lanoire
dialogues.text: I don't know what sort of cake Cater likes...

dialogues.speaker: Lanoire
dialogues.text: Oh, I was just wondering what flavor of cake I should make for Cater's birthday!

dialogues.speaker: Lanoire
dialogues.text: ...Because now that I think about it, Cater always gives me food, but I don't know what he likes to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Lanoire
dialogues.text: Does he like Bulle Fruit? Or Sunsettia? Actually, since he's that color, maybe he likes Mint?

dialogues.speaker: Lanoire
dialogues.text: #But, more importantly, I've gotta find Cater. Wait for me to grow up, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, and we'll go look for him together.

dialogues.speaker: Lanoire
dialogues.text: Okay! I'm definitely gonna make the most delicious birthday cake ever.

dialogues.speaker: Lanoire
dialogues.text: #Oh, I don't know your birthdays either, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, Ms. Paimon...
